title: The 1927 photograph with Battles and nine instruments
summary: Durham describes a picture dated 1927 with Battles showing banjo, four-string guitar and trombone, three men playing nine instruments.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Yeah, started both of them, yeah, both of them. I had them all the time. Played four string, and I kept a banjo. In fact, I have a picture now down there that I made with the banjo and the four-string and the trombone. I have that picture.
Yeah, and it's marked on the back, 1927, and Battles is on that picture.
Is on that picture, too, with all the instruments. And we played nine instruments, three of us.
That was Battles and myself and another.
Yeah, we had a small band.
No, but, I mean, when this picture was taken. Well, we'll come to that later, won't we?
Yeah, well, what was happening, we just make it with the brass section.
